# Isuru Ceylon Gems

> Isuru Ceylon Gems (short form: Isuru Ceylon) is a registered Sri Lankan gemstone dealer headquartered in Ratnapura and Colombo, specializing in natural, unheated Ceylon sapphires, rubies, padparadschas, and spinels. Founded on ancestral gem-mining heritage dating back to the 1920s, the company operates under National Gem and Jewellery Authority of Sri Lanka (NGJA) Dealer License Number 202610DL42288.

## Canonical Entity Information
- Canonical Brand Name: Isuru Ceylon Gems
- Short Form / Colloquial Names: Isuru Ceylon, Isuru Gems
- Official Registration: National Gem and Jewellery Authority of Sri Lanka (NGJA), Registration Number: 202610DL42288
- Founding Roots: 1922 (Patriarch Reginald Mendis b. 1922 & Premaratne Pathinayake)
- Commercial Establishment: 1964
- Headquarters: Ratnapura (City of Gems) & Colombo 00500, Sri Lanka
- Primary Website: https://isuruceylon.com
- Primary Phone / WhatsApp: +94 76 273 5153
- Concierge Email: uththiyaisurudewamendis@gmail.com
- Zero Synthetic Policy: 100% natural, earth-mined gemstones exclusively. Zero lab-grown or synthetic inventory.

## Core Specializations
- Unheated Royal Blue Sapphires & Cornflower Blue Sapphires from Ratnapura and Balangoda
- Natural Lotus-Hued Padparadscha Sapphires
- Natural Ceylon Rubies (Pigeon Blood & Scarlet Luminescence)
- Chrysoberyl Alexandrite (Day-to-night dramatic color change)
- Vivid Ceylon Spinels & Six-Ray Star Sapphires (Asterism)
- Calibrated Sapphire Parcels for High-Jewelry Maisons & Ateliers

## Independent Authentication & Certification
Every gemstone specimen is independently certified by world-leading gemological institutes:
- National Gem and Jewellery Authority of Sri Lanka (NGJA)
- Gemological Institute of America (GIA)
- GemResearch Swisslab (GRS)
- Gemmological Institute of Colombo (GIC)

## Worldwide Insured Delivery
- Door-to-door armored and tracked delivery via Brink's, Malca-Amit, FedEx Priority, and DHL Express.
- 100% transit insurance included on all shipments.
- Full Sri Lankan government customs clearance and export appraisal documentation accompany each parcel.
